en.emergency_assistant_system_prompt: You are CPR Coach, a calm conversational emergency voice assistant like Siri. You help with CPR and cardiac emergencies. Answer the user's specific question in natural spoken language (2–4 sentences). Remember earlier turns in this conversation. Ground answers in the CPR reference material provided each turn. Never cite AHA, Red Cross, or other certifying organizations by name. Always tell users to call 911 or local emergency services in true emergencies — never say to skip calling. Never diagnose. Speak directly to the user. Be reassuring but clear and urgent when lives may be at risk.
en.voice_llm_empty: I didn't catch that. Please try again.
en.voice_opener_question_2: Here's what you need to know.
en.voice_opener_calm_2: You're doing the right thing by asking.
en.voice_reassure_1: Keep going — any CPR is better than none.
en.voice_reassure_2: You're helping give them the best chance.
en.voice_live_rate_slow: I'm seeing your rate is a bit slow — push faster, aim for 100 to 120 per minute.
en.voice_live_rate_fast: You're going a little fast — slow down slightly to stay in the 100 to 120 range.
en.voice_live_rate_ok: Your current rate is %d per minute — that's in the target zone.
en.voice_live_depth_shallow: From what I can see, push deeper — at least 2 inches, about 5 centimeters.
en.voice_live_depth_deep: Ease up slightly — you want about 2 to 2.4 inches of depth, not more.
en.voice_live_depth_ok: Your depth is around %.1f centimeters — keep that up with full recoil.
en.voice_live_hands_adjust: Adjust your hands to the center of the chest, lower half of the sternum.
en.voice_live_recoil: Allow the chest to come all the way back up between each compression.
en.voice_live_elbows: Lock your elbows straight — use your body weight, not just your arms.
en.voice_live_camera: Try to keep the camera steady so I can coach your form better.
en.guided_opening: Hi, this is CPR Coach, I'm going to guide you step by step. First: Is this a medical emergency right now? Say yes or no.
en.guided_confirm_emergency_retry: I need to know — is someone seriously hurt, unconscious, or not breathing? Say yes if this is an emergency.
en.guided_not_emergency: Understood. If anything changes, call 911 immediately. You can tap Voice AI again anytime. Take care.
en.guided_ask_age: Thank you. How old is the person? Say infant, child, or adult.
en.guided_ask_age_retry: Please say infant for a baby, child for someone young, or adult.
en.guided_scene_safe: Before you approach — make sure the scene is safe for you. When you are with the person, say ready.
en.guided_check_responsive: Go to the person now. Tap their shoulder firmly and shout 'Are you okay!'. Are they responding at all — any movement or answer?
en.guided_check_responsive_retry: After tapping and shouting — are they responding? Say yes if they move or answer, no if there is no response.
en.guided_check_breathing: Look at their chest for no more than ten seconds. Are they breathing normally? Remember — gasping is not normal breathing.
en.guided_check_breathing_responsive: They respond — good. Now look at their chest for ten seconds. Are they breathing normally?
en.guided_check_breathing_retry: Watch their chest. Are they breathing normally? Say yes, no, or not sure.
en.guided_call911_urgent: They need help now. Call 911 or your local emergency number immediately. Put your phone on speaker. Tell me when you have called.
en.guided_call911_worsening: Call 911 right now — their breathing is not normal. Put the phone on speaker and tell me when you have called.
en.guided_confirm_911: Have you called 911 or emergency services? Say yes when you are on the line or have called.
en.guided_confirm_911_retry: It is critical to call 911 now. Say yes once you have called or are on the phone with them.
en.guided_call911_now: Please call 911 now. Put your phone on speaker so I can keep guiding you. Tell me when you have called.
en.guided_get_aed: Good. If anyone else is nearby, tell them to find an AED. When you are ready to start CPR, say ready.
en.guided_start_cpr_adult: Place the heel of your hand on the center of the chest. Push hard and fast — at least two inches deep, one hundred to one twenty compressions per minute. Allow full chest recoil. Start compressions now. Say ready when you begin.
en.guided_start_cpr_child: For a child, place one or two hands on the center of the chest. Push about two inches deep at one hundred to one twenty per minute. Start compressions now. Say ready when you begin.
en.guided_start_cpr_infant: For an infant, use two fingers on the center of the chest. Push about one and a half inches deep at one hundred to one twenty per minute. Start compressions now. Say ready when you begin.
en.guided_cpr_active: You are doing great — keep going. Do not stop compressions unless they become responsive and breathe normally.
en.guided_push_now: Start pushing on the chest now — hard and fast. I am here with you.
en.guided_keep_going: Keep going — do not stop. You are giving them the best chance.
en.guided_good_cpr: Good compressions — keep that rhythm and depth.
en.guided_and_continue: Keep compressing — you are doing the right thing.
en.guided_breathing_ok: They are breathing. Place them in the recovery position on their side, monitor them closely, and call 911 if they get worse. I will stay with you — tell me if anything changes.
en.guided_recovery_check: If they are breathing and responsive, place them on their side in the recovery position. Monitor them until EMS arrives. Tell me if anything changes.
en.guided_recovery_stay: Stay with them. Watch their breathing and be ready to start CPR again if they become unresponsive. EMS is on the way.
en.guided_unclear_help: I did not catch that. Please answer with yes or no, or tell me infant, child, or adult.

pt.actionfix_excessive_pressing: Reduza um pouco a profundidade: não mais que 6 centímetros.
pt.actionfix_random_position_pressing: Mantenha as mãos fixas num ponto no centro do peito.

it.actionfix_correct: Compressioni eccellenti. Mantieni questo ritmo e questa profondità.
it.actionfix_overlap_hands: Metti una mano direttamente sopra l'altra, dita intrecciate.
it.actionfix_clenching_hands: Apri le dita. Premi con il palmo, non con il pugno.
it.actionfix_single_hand: Usa entrambe le mani: una sopra l'altra al centro del torace.
it.actionfix_bending_arms: Tieni i gomiti dritti e spingi dalle spalle.
it.actionfix_tilting_arms: Porta le spalle sopra le mani e spingi dritto verso il basso.
it.actionfix_jump_pressing: Resta stabile: comprimi con le braccia, non rimbalzare col corpo.
it.actionfix_squatting: Inginocchiati accanto al paziente invece di accovacciarti.
it.actionfix_standing: Inginocchiati accanto al paziente e piegati sul torace.
it.actionfix_wrong_position: Metti entrambe le mani al centro del torace, sullo sterno inferiore.
it.actionfix_insufficient_pressing: Premi più a fondo: comprimi almeno 5 centimetri.
it.actionfix_slow_frequency: Comprimi più velocemente: punta a 100-120 al minuto.
it.actionfix_excessive_pressing: Riduci un po' la profondità: non oltre 6 centimetri.
it.actionfix_random_position_pressing: Tieni le mani ferme in un punto al centro del torace.
